title: Agents report their real version, not 0.1.0
instructions:
Every agent registers with `version: "0.1.0"` (hard-coded twice in src/swarm/worker-runner.ts, see the excerpts), so the coordinators and the portal cannot tell which release an agent runs.
- Create `src/common/app-version.ts` exporting `appVersion(): string`, which reads `version` from the repository's package.json the way src/common/error-tracking.ts does (`new URL("../../package.json", import.meta.url)`; the same relative path works from dist/common), caches it, and returns "unknown" if the file cannot be read or has no version.
- In src/swarm/worker-runner.ts replace both `version: "0.1.0"` with `version: appVersion()` and add the import (`../common/app-version.js`). Change nothing else in that file.
- Add `tests/common/app-version.test.ts`: appVersion() equals the version in package.json (read it in the test with readFileSync), is not "0.1.0" unless package.json says so, and returns the same value twice.
